units.characteristics: known and consecrated before birth; reluctance met with presence; the fortified prophet
units.gist: THE GEM - 'BEFORE I FORMED YOU IN THE WOMB I KNEW YOU, and before you were born I CONSECRATED you; I appointed you a prophet'; the reluctance 'I am only a YOUTH... I do not know how to speak'; 'DO NOT BE AFRAID... I AM WITH YOU to deliver you'; 'I have put my words in your mouth'; 'I make you a FORTIFIED CITY, an iron pillar' - identity/calling given before the self existed; fear met with presence

units.characteristics: forsaking the fountain for broken cisterns; the self-deceiving 'I am innocent'
units.gist: THE GEM - the bride who forgot her first love; 'my people have committed TWO EVILS: they have FORSAKEN ME, THE FOUNTAIN OF LIVING WATERS, and hewed out cisterns for themselves, BROKEN CISTERNS THAT CAN HOLD NO WATER'; 'the fear of me is not in you'; the stain that no soap removes; 'I am INNOCENT... I have not sinned' (self-deceiving denial) - abandoning the living source for self-made substitutes that leak

units.characteristics: the call to return; acknowledging guilt; God's readiness to heal faithlessness
units.gist: GEM - the divorced whoring wife, 'would you return to me?'; 'RETURN, faithless Israel... I am MERCIFUL, I will not be angry forever. ONLY ACKNOWLEDGE YOUR GUILT'; 'return, O faithless children... I WILL HEAL YOUR FAITHLESSNESS'; but Judah returned 'not with her whole heart but IN PRETENSE'; 'shepherds after my own heart' - the open door of return conditioned only on honest acknowledgement, refused by pretended repentance

units.characteristics: circumcise the heart; the lodging wicked thoughts; the prophet's anguish
units.gist: GEM - 'BREAK UP YOUR FALLOW GROUND, sow not among thorns; CIRCUMCISE yourselves to the LORD, REMOVE THE FORESKIN OF YOUR HEARTS'; 'wash your HEART from evil, that you may be saved. HOW LONG shall your wicked THOUGHTS LODGE WITHIN you?'; the prophet's cry 'MY ANGUISH! I writhe in pain! the walls of my heart! I cannot keep silent'; 'my people... know me not' - the inner soil broken open; the prophet's own torn heart

units.characteristics: faces harder than rock; the stubborn heart that will not fear; loving the false
units.gist: GEM - searching for one who does justice; 'you have struck them but they felt no anguish... they made their FACES HARDER THAN ROCK; they REFUSED TO REPENT'; 'this people has a STUBBORN AND REBELLIOUS HEART'; 'they do not say IN THEIR HEARTS, Let us FEAR the LORD'; the prophets prophesy falsely 'and MY PEOPLE LOVE TO HAVE IT SO' - the correction-proof face; the heart that will not fear; the love of comfortable lies

units.characteristics: the ancient paths and rest for the soul, refused; the shameless who cannot blush
units.gist: THE GEM - 'STAND BY THE ROADS and look, and ask for the ANCIENT PATHS, where the GOOD WAY is, and walk in it, and FIND REST FOR YOUR SOULS. BUT THEY SAID, WE WILL NOT WALK IN IT'; 'Peace, peace, when there is NO PEACE'; 'were they ashamed? No... they DID NOT KNOW HOW TO BLUSH'; 'their ears are uncircumcised, they take no pleasure in [the word]'; the refining that fails - rest offered on the old good way and refused; the conscience that cannot blush
